description:
**Company Description**
EVE DESIGNS AND INTERIORS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED is an interior design company based in Coimbatore, India, serving clients with tailored design solutions. The company focuses on creating functional and aesthetically pleasing spaces for residential, commercial, and hospitality projects. EVE DESIGNS AND INTERIORS emphasizes quality, attention to detail, and client collaboration throughout the design process. Prospective team members can expect to work in a professional environment that values creativity, innovation, and practical design execution.
  
**Role Description**
The Interior Designer will be responsible for developing design concepts, space plans, and layouts for a variety of projects, ensuring both functionality and visual appeal. Day-to-day tasks include meeting with clients to understand their requirements, preparing mood boards and presentations, creating detailed drawings and specifications, and coordinating with contractors and vendors during project execution. * Knowledge of Architecture and Construction Drawings to develop accurate plans and coordinate effectively with contractors and consultants.

* Relevant diploma or degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field, with prior experience in interior design projects.

* Attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and willingness to work on-site in Coimbatore throughout the project lifecycle.
